definitions.explanation: The act of throwing away or selling something no longer needed.
A penalty or action taken against someone who has done wrong.

examples.japanese: {不用品|ふようひん}を{処分|しょぶん}する。
{懲戒|ちょうかい}{処分|しょぶん}を{受|う}けた。
{書類|しょるい}を{処分|しょぶん}する。

notes:
{処分|しょぶん} has two distinct meanings: disposing of unwanted items, and taking disciplinary action. Context determines which meaning applies.

SENSE 1 - DISPOSAL:
- {不用品|ふようひん}を{処分|しょぶん}する: dispose of unwanted items
- {書類|しょるい}を{処分|しょぶん}する: dispose of documents
- {処分|しょぶん}{品|ひん}: clearance/disposal items (for sale)

SENSE 2 - PUNISHMENT:
- {懲戒|ちょうかい}{処分|しょぶん}: disciplinary action
- {処分|しょぶん}を{受|う}ける: to receive punishment
- {処分|しょぶん}を{下|くだ}す: to hand down a punishment

RELATED WORDS:
- {廃棄|はいき}: disposal, scrapping
- {罰|ばつ}: punishment
- {制裁|せいさい}: sanction
